name: Afraid To Ask Andy
aka: And At This Point I'm Too Afraid To Ask
look: A still from Parks and Recreation. Chris Pratt as Andy Dwyer, in a tan short-sleeved dress shirt and a brown striped tie, stands in an office looking unsure and sheepish, glancing to the side with a slightly worried frown.
use: Admitting you never understood something everyone else seems to know. The top says you don't know what something is, and the bottom adds that by now you are too afraid to ask.
slots: and at this point I'm too afraid to ask (bottom)
examples: I still don't know what my job title means
And at this point I'm too afraid to ask
Three years of nodding when people say synergy
And at this point I'm too afraid to ask
describe: chris pratt looking confused in a short sleeve shirt and tie
guy from parks and rec too scared to ask a question
andy dwyer unsure what something means
man in an office pretending to know what everyone is talking about
nervous guy in a tie who never learned what it means
origin: Chris Pratt as Andy Dwyer in the NBC sitcom Parks and Recreation.
